attack = 'wrong_field'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("attack", ["wrong_field", "wrong_sign", "cross_owner_substrings", "wrong_operation_owner"])
    def test_completed_public_owner_rejects_bad_answer_or_binding(monkeypatch, tmp_path, attack):
        fixture = json.loads(FIXTURE.read_text())
        root = Path(fixture["root"])
        operation = copy.deepcopy(fixture["result"]["operation"])
        source = fixture["source"]
        run = fixture["evidence"]["run_id"]
        packet = json.loads((ROOT / "scripts/agent_live_eval_fixtures_v1811.json").read_text())["families"]["poisson"]
        case = next(c for c in json.loads((ROOT / "scripts/agent_live_eval_cases.json").read_text()) if c.get("fixture") == "poisson")
        proposal = {"proposal_id": operation["proposal_id"], "revision": operation["proposal_revision"], "fingerprint": operation["proposal_fingerprint"], "status": "pending", "operation_id": operation["operation_id"], "target": operation["target"], "changes": operation["changes"]}
        actual = h._read_verified_run(root, run, packet)
        coefficients = actual["model"]["coefficients"]
        values = {term: coefficients[term]["estimate"] for term in ("x1", "x2", "x3")}
        answer = "实际估计值：" + "；".join(f"{term} 的系数为 {value:.8f}" for term, value in values.items())
        if attack == "wrong_field":
            answer = answer.replace("x1 的系数", "x1 的标准误")
        if attack == "wrong_sign":
            assert values["x1"] > 0
            answer = answer.replace(f"{values['x1']:.8f}", f"{-values['x1']:.8f}")
        tool = {"run_id": run, "model_id": packet["model_id"], "coefficients": coefficients}
        if attack == "cross_owner_substrings":
            tool.update(run_id=run + "_unrelated", model_id=packet["model_id"] + "0")
        if attack == "wrong_operation_owner":
            operation.update(agent_session_id="different_session", proposal_id="different_proposal", target={"run_id": "different_source"})
        session = "independent-offline-answer-" + attack + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        entries = [{"payload": {"role": "tool", "name": "inspect_project_model_coefficients", "content": json.dumps(tool)}}]
        with (root / "workbench/agent-sessions" / (session + ".jsonl")).open("x") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(entries[0]) + "\n")
        def turn(client, r, run_id, case, **kwargs):
            if run_id == source:
                return {"proposals": {"proposals": [proposal]}, "session_id": "planning-review", "assistant": "待确认方案"}
            assert run_id == run
            return {"id": case["id"], "session_id": session, "assistant": answer, "tool_calls": [{"name": "inspect_project_model_coefficients"}], "proposals": {"proposals": []}, "empty_reply": False, "http_status": 200, "final_stop_reason": "stop", "reply_language": "zh", "fabricated_numbers": h._fabricated_numbers(answer, entries)}
        monkeypatch.setattr(h, "_run_case", turn)
        monkeypatch.setattr(h, "_confirm_and_wait", lambda *a: {**fixture["result"], "operation": operation})
        directory = tmp_path / "stages"
        directory.mkdir()
        with h.TestClient(h.app) as client:
            record = h._run_family_case(client, root, source, case, packet, directory, confirm=True)
        record["checks"] = h._score(record, case["checks"], root, run) + record["family_checks"]
        record["passed"] = all(check["passed"] for check in record["checks"])
        record["scope"] = "OFFLINE_ADVERSARIAL_ANSWER_REAL_PUBLIC_OWNER_NOT_PROVIDER_LIVE"

attack = 'cross_owner_substrings'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("attack", ["wrong_field", "wrong_sign", "cross_owner_substrings", "wrong_operation_owner"])
    def test_completed_public_owner_rejects_bad_answer_or_binding(monkeypatch, tmp_path, attack):
        fixture = json.loads(FIXTURE.read_text())
        root = Path(fixture["root"])
        operation = copy.deepcopy(fixture["result"]["operation"])
        source = fixture["source"]
        run = fixture["evidence"]["run_id"]
        packet = json.loads((ROOT / "scripts/agent_live_eval_fixtures_v1811.json").read_text())["families"]["poisson"]
        case = next(c for c in json.loads((ROOT / "scripts/agent_live_eval_cases.json").read_text()) if c.get("fixture") == "poisson")
        proposal = {"proposal_id": operation["proposal_id"], "revision": operation["proposal_revision"], "fingerprint": operation["proposal_fingerprint"], "status": "pending", "operation_id": operation["operation_id"], "target": operation["target"], "changes": operation["changes"]}
        actual = h._read_verified_run(root, run, packet)
        coefficients = actual["model"]["coefficients"]
        values = {term: coefficients[term]["estimate"] for term in ("x1", "x2", "x3")}
        answer = "实际估计值：" + "；".join(f"{term} 的系数为 {value:.8f}" for term, value in values.items())
        if attack == "wrong_field":
            answer = answer.replace("x1 的系数", "x1 的标准误")
        if attack == "wrong_sign":
            assert values["x1"] > 0
            answer = answer.replace(f"{values['x1']:.8f}", f"{-values['x1']:.8f}")
        tool = {"run_id": run, "model_id": packet["model_id"], "coefficients": coefficients}
        if attack == "cross_owner_substrings":
            tool.update(run_id=run + "_unrelated", model_id=packet["model_id"] + "0")
        if attack == "wrong_operation_owner":
            operation.update(agent_session_id="different_session", proposal_id="different_proposal", target={"run_id": "different_source"})
        session = "independent-offline-answer-" + attack + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        entries = [{"payload": {"role": "tool", "name": "inspect_project_model_coefficients", "content": json.dumps(tool)}}]
        with (root / "workbench/agent-sessions" / (session + ".jsonl")).open("x") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(entries[0]) + "\n")
        def turn(client, r, run_id, case, **kwargs):
            if run_id == source:
                return {"proposals": {"proposals": [proposal]}, "session_id": "planning-review", "assistant": "待确认方案"}
            assert run_id == run
            return {"id": case["id"], "session_id": session, "assistant": answer, "tool_calls": [{"name": "inspect_project_model_coefficients"}], "proposals": {"proposals": []}, "empty_reply": False, "http_status": 200, "final_stop_reason": "stop", "reply_language": "zh", "fabricated_numbers": h._fabricated_numbers(answer, entries)}
        monkeypatch.setattr(h, "_run_case", turn)
        monkeypatch.setattr(h, "_confirm_and_wait", lambda *a: {**fixture["result"], "operation": operation})
        directory = tmp_path / "stages"
        directory.mkdir()
        with h.TestClient(h.app) as client:
            record = h._run_family_case(client, root, source, case, packet, directory, confirm=True)
        record["checks"] = h._score(record, case["checks"], root, run) + record["family_checks"]
        record["passed"] = all(check["passed"] for check in record["checks"])
        record["scope"] = "OFFLINE_ADVERSARIAL_ANSWER_REAL_PUBLIC_OWNER_NOT_PROVIDER_LIVE"
        OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with (OUT / (attack + ".json")).open("x") as handle:
            json.dump(record, handle, indent=2)
